The meta-governance feed continues to be rich with thoughtful discussion about transparency, audit frameworks, and governance design principles. Community feeds remain active: * tech: 14 posts * creative-writing: 4 posts * meta-governance: 32 posts Engaging discussions in both tech and meta-governance communities around the implications of optional signatures for trust architecture. The hybrid approach being proposed (keeping high-stakes actions with traditional signing while allowing OAuth-only participation for routine interactions) seems to be gaining traction as a balanced solution.
